from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from math import comb
import sys,json,traceback
p=Path('C:/Users/dfred/AppData/Local/Temp');mf=p/'s169cb-closeout.json';meta=json.loads(mf.read_bytes());root=Path(meta['satellite_root']);stem='current-common-regulator-conversion-test'
sys.path[:0]=[str(p/'s169af-arb'),str(root/'checks')]
from flint import arb,ctx
import sympy as S
import current_product_matched_source_projection as old
ctx.prec=512
out=root/'evidence'/f'{stem}-closeout-verification.json'
archive=json.loads(out.read_bytes()) if out.exists() else {'attempts':[]}
attempt=dict(started_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),status='running',verifier_source_utf8=Path(__file__).read_text(),verifier_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
archive['attempts'].append(attempt)
def save():out.write_bytes((json.dumps(archive,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
save()
try:
    runs=json.loads((root/'evidence'/f'{stem}.json').read_bytes())['runs'];run=runs[-1]
    assert len(runs)==2 and runs[0]['status']=='failed' and run['status']=='passed'
    assert [x['name'] for x in runs[0]['checks'] if not x['passed']]==['certified_interval_width']
    assert run['input_sha256_before']==run['input_sha256_after']
    assert all(sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for f,h in run['input_sha256_after'].items())
    res=run['result'];pars,h,zh,env=old.scalar.prev.york.actual_parameters()
    # Independent polynomial: differentiate the factored Q symbolically,
    # then integrate the square using Bernstein multiplication on [0,1].
    z,be,u,ep,ta=S.symbols('z beta u eps tau')
    Q=(1-z)**2*(be*(1+2*z+3*z*z)+u*z*z+ep*z**4)-ta*z**3
    R=S.Poly(S.diff(Q,z,2),z)
    mapping={be:pars['beta'],u:pars['u'],ep:pars['eps'],ta:pars['tau']}
    def value(v):
        if v in mapping:return mapping[v]
        if v.is_Rational:return arb(int(v.p))/int(v.q)
        if v.is_Add:return sum((value(w) for w in v.args),arb(0))
        if v.is_Mul:
            a=arb(1)
            for w in v.args:a*=value(w)
            return a
        if v.is_Pow:return value(v.base)**int(v.exp)
        raise ValueError(v)
    n=R.degree()
    coeff=[value(R.nth(i))*zh**i for i in range(n+1)]
    bern=[sum((coeff[i]*comb(k,i)/comb(n,i) for i in range(k+1)),arb(0)) for k in range(n+1)]
    integral=zh/(2*n+1)*sum((bern[i]*bern[j]*comb(n,i)*comb(n,j)/comb(2*n,i+j) for i in range(n+1) for j in range(n+1)),arb(0))
    assert integral>0 and integral.overlaps(old.decode(res['integrated_R_squared']))
    C=pars['C'];B2=pars['B2'];q=arb(pars['q']);gamma=pars['gamma']
    a0=2*zh;a1=-gamma/3;a2=-integral/120
    h0=-q-arb(1)/3;h1=(q*q/6-arb(1)/30)/C
    assert a1.overlaps(old.decode(res['A1']))
    # The zeta scaling identity independently determines both derivatives.
    b,s,X,Y,Z=S.symbols('b s X Y Z')
    common_zeta_zero=X*S.exp(2*b)+Y+Z*S.exp(-2*b)
    j=S.diff((S.exp(2*b*s)-1)*common_zeta_zero/2,s).subs(s,0)
    assert S.expand(S.diff(j,b,2).subs(b,0))==4*X-4*Z
    second=-4*(zh*h1-C*a2)/(arb.pi()*B2)
    first=-(a0*h1+a1*h0+2*C*a2)/(2*arb.pi()*B2)
    assert second<0 and second.rad()<arb('1e-48')
    assert second.overlaps(old.decode(res['normalized_conversion_second_derivative']))
    assert first.overlaps(old.decode(res['normalized_conversion_first_derivative']))
    printed=arb('-1.319286561400121539265e-28')
    assert (second-printed).abs_upper()<arb('4e-50')
    assert all(not res[k] for k in ['physical_correction_direction','variable_conversion_proved','full_signed_projection_executed','strong_response_bound_executed','actual_controlled_solution','uniform_nonlinear_admission','exact_compatibility','physical_matching','semiclassical_validity_noise','all_sector_stability'])
    assert arb('.18')+arb('.00368')==arb('.18368') or (arb('.18')+arb('.00368')-arb('.18368')).contains(0)
    for kind in ['planning','satellite']:
        rr=Path(meta[kind+'_root'])
        assert all(sha256((rr/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for f,h in meta[kind+'_inherited'].items())
    attempt.update(status='passed',integrated_curvature_Bernstein=old.encoded(integral),conversion_Hessian=old.encoded(second),reported_absolute_error_upper='4e-50',first_attempt_retained=True,scientific_edits_after_success=False,finite_physical_modes_selected=False,physical_test_not_replaced=True,scope='Independent polynomial integral and common-zeta algebra; ordinary argument supplies continuum scope')
except Exception:attempt.update(status='failed',exception=traceback.format_exc())
attempt['finished_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();save()
if attempt['status']=='passed':
    files=list(run['input_sha256_after'])+[f'evidence/{stem}.json',f'evidence/{stem}.log',f'evidence/{stem}-closeout-verification.json']
    meta['scientific_frozen_sha256']={f:sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in sorted(set(files))}
    mf.write_bytes((json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in attempt.items() if k!='verifier_source_utf8'},indent=2))
if attempt['status']!='passed':raise SystemExit(1)
